thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize success metrics and the lean feedback loop for the Partner Pilot starting next week. 15m check-in?
ajay: on it. Proposal: 6 partners, 3 weeks, outputs = 30 eval prompts/partner, 1 weekly session + recorded notes.
ben: can we push to 8 partners? our funnel looks good but ops might complain.
sophie: scope request — freeze model changes during pilot unless it's a high-severity bug. also we need latency SLOs pinned per route.
maria: sounds right. Draft launch gates I'm thinking: 1) >70% partner task completion rate; 2) <=1 critical regression vs baseline; 3) p95 token latency <200ms on hosted route.
tom: how strictly are we defining "critical regression"? we should publish a tiny severity matrix.
noor: quick stab: critical = data loss / broken outputs that block workflows; major = repeated incorrect outputs that require manual fixes; minor = UI/UX or transient formatting. I'll put formal defs in the doc.
ajay: ops note — I'll automate a weekly digest. sample template: ```
Weekly pilot digest
- partners: [names]
- active tasks completed: X/Y
- quality regressions: {critical: n, major: n}
- avg p95 latency: 132ms
- open asks: []
```
ben: recruiting script idea: one-line outreach + ask for 30m onboarding + NDA opt-in. incentive: $500 platform credit. keeps commitment high.
sophie: feedback loop plan: 1) in-app 3-question pulse after sessions; 2) scheduled 1:1s with product; 3) shared Notion board for continuous notes. also propose we run our automated eval harness nightly to surface hallucination/regression trends.
maria: agreement checklist: finalize gating doc today. ajay, lock partner list by EOD? ben, confirm incentive budget? :pray:
ajay: locked 6 partners for now, pushing list into #product ops doc. will confirm budget with finance and post update.
deploy-bot: deploy: pilot-config-v1 promoted to staging at 11:23am by ajay
noor: I'll draft the severity matrix + acceptance checklist and drop into the pilot doc. ETA tomorrow noon.
tom: small ops reminder — include rollback plan: model-variant fallback + canned partner comms template.
maria: :thumbsup: one last ask — add a capture hook for cached prompts so metrics won't be skewed by prefix caching. will follow up with a short spec.
